player_prompt.intro:
Yawa otimo Mastermind.
Wapendeza ok findi code kendo {code_length} digits dhi, kawuok dhi 1 hadi {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Ka wapimo, ichamo submit guess yawa kwa fomati hii: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Baada ya kila guess, uwache feedback kama tic nyago na white.
Tic nyago inaonyesha digit sawa kwa nafasi sawa, wakati tic white inaonyesha digit sawa lakini si kwa nafasi sawa.
Unayo {max_turns} mikwambe kuamua code.
player_prompt.with_repeats: ma nyalo bedo ni osetim nyadinwoya.
player_prompt.no_duplicates: ma onge kopi mag weche mamoko,

invalid_move.wrong_format: You did not respond with a space-separated list of numbers wrapped in square brackets.
invalid_move.not_integers: Weche duto moket nyaka bed kwan mar adimba.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Paro ma ng'ato onego obedgo en mana {code_length}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nambano duto nyaka bed e kind 1 gi {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Iseng'eyo {guess}. Tem paro machielo, kiyiero mar 0?

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: Wuon achiel, gi sokoreng' {black_pegs} kati {code_length} tic, kwelo.
outcome.turn_limit: Okang' mar loko oserumo. Isechako goyo namba e % {percent} mag kwan duto ma kare.
